scenario: [LSER.17.2]: the check on a `sum` read is the `time` slot's alone. This is `LSER.17.2_duration_sum_past_range_raises`'s totals over an `Int` slot on `all_time`: 2^63 - 1 and 2 wrap to -9223372036854775807 and the read does not raise. `read` logs the value, once per fact of the `ttl` schema, and `handler` does not fire. Exactly ["-9223372036854775807", "-9223372036854775807"]. A compiler that checked every `sum` read raises here. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete`'s series read, whose `k_duration` test keeps `FN_DURATION_ADD` off an `Int` slot.
rules_ds:
use default

schema T scope ttl 1_h:
    k: String
    v: Int

schema Probe scope explicit:
    k: Int

series T.v (by: k):
    sum all_time

rule read:
    Probe
    T t
->
    log info "{t.sum}"

rule handler:
    ComputationError c
->
    log info "{c.kind}"
